notes.title: My new game "Legend of Merchant 2" has launched its store page.
notes.content:
[b]Whether you plan to buy in the future or not, adding the game to your wishlist is a form of support for the developer.[/b]
[b]As a solo game developer, I'm still on my own, but this time I'm investing a significant amount of funds into the creation of art resources.[/b]
[b]However, the game won't be available for sale immediately. Before that, I will open a demo version for everyone to experience as soon as possible.[/b]

[h1][h3]Please add it to your wishlist![/h3][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2092160/
